centŭrĭālis , e, adj. centuria,
I. pertaining to a century.
1. In agriculture: lapides, boundary stones for single centuries, Auct. Lim. p. 298 Goes.—
2. In the division of the people: civis, appointed to or placed in any century, Fest. s. v. ni quis scivit, p. 177 Müll.—
3. In milit. lang.: “vitis,” Macr. S. 1, 23, 16 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
